### Century Communities to Celebrate September Grand Opening at Mirabella, an Italian-Inspired New Home Community in Brookshire, TX, Near Katy


September 10, 2026


Mirabella joins Century Communities' growing West Houston lineup with two collections of new homes from the low $200s


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Grand Opening event:** Century Communities will celebrate the Grand Opening of Mirabella in Brookshire, TX, on Saturday, September 12 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., with a tailgate-themed celebration featuring burgers, yard games and face painting.
- **A growing West Houston lineup:** Mirabella is Century Communities' newest community positioned to meet demand along the West Houston corridor, joining Sunterra Lakes directly across the street, Laurel Farms in Brookshire, Katy Reserve in Katy, and Fulshear Junction and Fulshear Lakes in Fulshear.
- **Italian-inspired setting:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX draws its name and its character from an Italian theme carried through the community design, including lakes, waterways and walking trails.
- **Two home collections:** Mirabella offers 18 single-family floor plans across the Lonestar Collection and the Liberty Collection, ranging from 1,388 to 2,657 square feet, 3 to 5 bedrooms, and 2 to 3 bathrooms, priced from the low $200s. The community has 1,192 planned homesites.
- **Planned amenities:** Mirabella will offer a range of planned amenities across 318 acres, including two amenity sites—a recreation center with a pool and playground, and a second site with a pickleball court and dog park—plus lakes, a fishing area, walking trails, parks and open green space.
- **Location and schools:** Mirabella sits 37 miles from Houston near the I-10 corridor, within reach of Katy-area shopping and dining. The community is also conveniently close to schools, including a new planned high school within Royal ISD.


BROOKSHIRE, Texas


, Sept. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will host a Grand Opening celebration at Mirabella, its newest West Houston community, on Saturday, September 12 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. The tailgate-themed event in Brookshire will welcome visitors for burgers, yard games and face painting as they tour two fully furnished new model homes and explore available homes. New homes at the Italian-inspired community are now selling from the low $200s across two floor plan collections.


**Learn more, explore available homes and RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/MirabellaGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771673-1&h=1148807211&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FMirabellaGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FMirabellaGO) **.**


"We're excited to introduce Mirabella as the latest addition to our new home lineup in the fast-growing West Houston corridor," said Division President Tanya Rizzo. "With 18 floor plans across two home collections, a convenient location near Katy, and access to planned community amenities and beautiful, Italian-themed waterways, we can't wait for homebuyers to come discover Mirabella and find the right new home to meet their needs."


Featuring 318 acres and 1,192 planned homesites, Mirabella joins several other projects by Century Communities designed to meet strong homebuyer demand in the dynamic and fast-growing West Houston corridor. The community is located across the street from Sunterra Lakes and down the road from Laurel Farms, Katy Reserve, Fulshear Junction and Fulshear Lakes.


The community takes its name and its character from the Italian theme carried throughout the community, including lakes, waterways and trails running through the neighborhood. Two amenity sites are planned: a recreation center with a pool and playground, and a second site with a pickleball court and dog park, plus a fishing area, parks and open green space.


The Lonestar Collection features eight single-family plans from 1,388 to 2,439 square feet, priced from the low $200s. The Liberty Collection features 10 plans from 1,446 to 2,657 square feet, priced from the mid $200s. All plans come with exceptional included features like quartz countertops, LG® appliances, Kohler® water fixtures, and the builder's Century Home Connect® smart home package.


**MIRABELLA | BROOKSHIRE, TX** *Grand Opening on 9/12 | Now selling from the low $200s*


- 318-acre, Italian-inspired community with two home collections (Lonestar and Liberty)
- 1,192 homesites
- 18 single-family floor plans
- 1,388 to 2,657 square feet, 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms
- Quartz countertops, Century Home Connect® smart home package, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® water fixtures and more included
- Planned amenities: recreation center with pool and playground, pickleball court, dog park
- Lakes, waterways, fishing area, walking trails, parks and open green space
- Zoned to Royal ISD, with a new comprehensive high school opening around the corner from Mirabella
- Convenient proximity to Houston with access to the I-10 corridor and Katy-area shopping and dining


**Community Location** 1454 Catalina Drive

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** When is the Grand Opening at Mirabella in Brookshire, TX?
**Answer:** The Grand Opening at Mirabella in Brookshire, TX is Saturday, September 12 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at 1454 Catalina Drive. The tailgate-themed event includes model home tours, burgers, yard games and face painting.


**Question:** What amenities are planned at Mirabella?
**Answer:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX has two planned amenity sites: a recreation center with a pool and playground, and a second site with a pickleball court and dog park. The community also plans lakes, a fishing area, walking trails, parks and open green space.


**Question:** How big is Mirabella?
**Answer:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX is a 318-acre community planned for 1,192 homesites.


**Question:** How far is Mirabella from Houston?
**Answer:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX sits 37 miles from Houston, near the I-10 corridor. Katy-area shopping and dining are a short drive away.


**Question:** How much do new homes at Mirabella cost?
**Answer:** New homes at Mirabella in Brookshire, TX start from the low $200s. The Lonestar Collection starts from the low $200s and the Liberty Collection starts from the mid $200s.


**Question:** What floor plans are available at Mirabella?
**Answer:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX offers 18 single-family floor plans across two collections, ranging from 1,388 to 2,657 square feet. Plans offer 3 to 5 bedrooms, and 2 to 3 bathrooms.


**Question:** What other new home communities does Century Communities offer in West Houston?
**Answer:** Along with Mirabella in Brookshire, TX, Century Communities offers Sunterra Lakes and Laurel Farms in Brookshire, Katy Reserve in Katy, and Fulshear Junction and Fulshear Lakes in Fulshear.


**Question:** What school district serves Mirabella?
**Answer:** Mirabella in Brookshire, TX is zoned to Royal ISD, which includes Royal Elementary, Royal Junior High School and Royal High School—with plans for a new comprehensive high school campus.
